articles.title: Puka Nacua Has Rare 'Psoas' Injury, Latest on Rams Star's Status vs. 49ers in NFL TNF Opener
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Rams are expecting wide receiver Puka Nacua to suit up for their opener against the San Francisco 49ers on Thursday night, head coach Sean McVay said (via ESPN's Adam Schefter).
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Rams are expecting wide receiver Puka Nacua to suit up for their opener against the San Francisco 49ers on Thursday night, head coach Sean McVay said (via ESPN's Adam Schefter ).

According to ESPN's Jeremy Fowler, Nacua picked up a psoas injury during an August practice. The injury affects the lower half of the body, with Fowler saying, "You don't hear that very often."

"They held him out for a few weeks, taking it easy with him, but he's been back in stride this week, no setbacks," the NFL insider reported on the star pass-catcher.

McVay spoke positively about Nacua earlier this week:

The two-time Pro Bowler led the NFL in receptions (129) and finished with 1,715 yards and 10 touchdowns in 2025. He made his first All-Pro team.

The 2026 season could be a pivotal one for Nacua as he's headed for free agency in the spring. He could plausibly overtake the Seattle Seahawks' Jaxon Smith-Njigba ($42.2 million) as the league's highest-paid receiver when he signs his next contract.

At the very least, another 1,000-yard campaign would likely put Nacua into the $40 million region.

For their part, the Rams are counting on the 25-year-old to help anchor the passing game. They were already all-in on chasing another Super Bowl title, and they doubled down further by acquiring Myles Garrett and coaxing Aaron Donald out of retirement.

Los Angeles' Week 1 matchup could have playoff implications when considering the Rams and Niners finished with the same record a season ago. Having Nacua on the field will be a big boost to the offense.

articles.title: "It's just sad, man": Antonio Brown joins OnlyFans, fans call it his biggest downfall yet
articles.summary: NFL News: Antonio Brown has once again found himself at the center of an NFL-related controversy, but this time it has nothing to do with what he did on the foo.
articles.body: Antonio Brown has once again found himself at the center of an NFL-related controversy, but this time it has nothing to do with what he did on the football field. The former Pittsburgh Steelers star recently announced that he has joined OnlyFans, teasing fans with a message claiming he is the “first hall of famer to pull out the tape” and revealing that a “full vid” was already available on his account.From NFL superstar to OnlyFans? Antonio Brown's latest move has fans calling it his ‘biggest downfall’The announcement quickly sparked reactions across social media, with some NFL fans viewing Brown’s latest move as another startling chapter in what they consider one of the most dramatic downfalls in football history.Brown was once one of the most dominant wide receivers in the NFL. During his peak with the Steelers, he became a seven-time Pro Bowler and four-time first-team All-Pro, establishing himself as one of the league's most productive pass catchers.His career, however, took a dramatic turn after a series of controversies and off-field incidents. Brown eventually left the NFL following his infamous departure from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in 2021, when he abruptly removed his uniform and left the field during a game.Now, years after his playing career effectively ended, Brown's OnlyFans announcement has reignited the conversation surrounding his career trajectory.Some fans have described the move as evidence of an extraordinary “downfall,” particularly when compared with the status Brown once held in the NFL.The Hall of Fame reference has also generated attention. Brown is eligible for the Pro Football Hall of Fame's 2027 class, but he has not been inducted. His suggestion that he will become a Hall of Famer is therefore a prediction rather than a confirmed achievement.That distinction has not stopped Brown from leaning into the Hall of Fame angle while promoting his new venture. The former receiver has not publicly provided extensive details about what exactly is contained in the teased video, leaving fans to speculate about what his OnlyFans account will feature.For many fans, however, the bigger story is the contrast.Brown went from being one of the NFL's most feared wide receivers, commanding massive contracts and regularly dominating defenses, to becoming a social-media personality whose latest announcement has little connection to football.That contrast is precisely why the OnlyFans announcement has generated such a strong reaction.Whether Brown's latest move represents another low point or simply another business decision depends largely on perspective. But one thing is clear: few NFL careers have taken a more unpredictable path than Antonio Brown's.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Is Aaron Rodgers’ mystery wife pregnant? QB drops major baby hint after retirement
articles.summary: NFL News: Aaron Rodgers is already looking beyond his final NFL season, and his plans for life after football are becoming much more personal. The Pittsburgh St.
articles.body: Aaron Rodgers is already looking beyond his final NFL season, and his plans for life after football are becoming much more personal. The Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback has said he hopes to start a family with his wife, Brittani, once his playing career ends. Rodgers, 42, has confirmed that the 2026 NFL season will be his final one, making his next chapter outside football very different from the life he has known for more than two decades.Aaron Rodgers reveals surprising plans with wife Brittani after retirement: “I can’t wait”During a preview of his upcoming interview with Adam Schein on SiriusXM's Mad Dog Sports Radio, Rodgers was asked what he hopes life will look like after his retirement.His answer immediately turned toward family.“I'm hopefully going to be supporting my pregnant wife because we're going to start a family,” Rodgers said, adding that he wants to step away from the spotlight and enjoy “a life of quiet” after his 22 years in the NFL and three years playing college football. He also said he wants to focus on getting his body healthy and “working on a family.”But there was an important clarification.Aaron Rodgers reveals he hopes wife Brittani will be pregnant by next yearDespite the wording of his initial answer, Brittani is not currently pregnant. Rodgers later clarified that he was talking about what he hopes will happen by this time next year.“I'm talking about I'm hoping that I have a pregnant wife by next [year] this time,” Rodgers explained.That means Rodgers was not announcing a pregnancy. Instead, he was revealing that having children is now one of his biggest goals once his NFL career is over. And it appears the desire has grown from spending more time with his extended family.Rodgers said he has been enjoying his role as “Uncle Aaron,” spending time with his brother's children and his godchildren. Being around them, he explained, has made both him and Brittani more excited about having children of their own.“I'm definitely excited about it,” Rodgers said. “Being back in my family's lives, I'm having a lot of fun being Uncle Aaron.”He added that the more time he spends with his nieces and nephews, “the more I get excited, and so does the wife, about having some of our own.”Rodgers isn't simply talking about the glamorous side of fatherhood, either.He said he is looking forward to everything that comes with having children, including the parts that could make his post-NFL life considerably less quiet.“I can't wait for that next chapter of life and all that that entails, and sleepless nights and crying babies and changing diapers and all those things,” Rodgers said. “I'm looking forward to all of it.”The comments offer a rare glimpse into the private life Rodgers has been building away from football. Rodgers and Brittani married privately in spring 2025, and he has deliberately kept details about his wife and their relationship away from the public eye. He has previously explained that Brittani is a private person and does not want to be part of the celebrity spotlight.Rodgers has also indicated that he wants his life after football to be much quieter. Rather than immediately jumping into another high-profile career, he is looking forward to stepping away, recovering physically, and spending more time with his family.For a quarterback who has spent 22 seasons living under the constant pressure of the NFL, Rodgers' vision of retirement is surprisingly simple.No packed schedule. No weekly media appearances. No football pressure. Just Brittani, a family of their own and, if everything goes according to plan, a few sleepless nights, crying babies, and plenty of diapers.For Rodgers, that appears to be exactly what he wants his next chapter to look like.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Why did Travis Kelce buy a $5.35M mansion in Ohio? The mystery deepens
articles.summary: NFL News: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have seemingly built their life around some of the biggest cities and most glamorous destinations in America. So why did.
articles.body: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have seemingly built their life around some of the biggest cities and most glamorous destinations in America. So why did the newlyweds quietly add a sprawling $5.35 million mansion in Ohio to their real-estate portfolio? That is the question surrounding the couple’s unexpected property purchase, and the answer may have more to do with Kelce’s past than Swift’s superstar lifestyle.Travis Kelce’s $5.35M Ohio mansion has everyone asking the same questionKelce purchased the lakefront estate in Bratenahl, Ohio, in March 2026, just months before his wedding celebrations with Swift in New York. The timing alone has made the property an intriguing addition to the couple’s story.Located only a few miles from Kelce’s childhood home in Cleveland Heights, the mansion gives the NFL star something he cannot get from their other high-profile properties: a connection to where his story began.But the property is hardly an ordinary hometown house.Known as “Moyenage,” the approximately 21,000-square-foot estate sits on 3.5 acres overlooking Lake Erie. It has eight bedrooms, 11 bathrooms, seven fireplaces, a heated pool, and enough space for a five-car garage.And then there is the part of the mansion’s history that sounds almost too fitting for a celebrity couple.The property’s former ballroom reportedly operated as a Prohibition-era speakeasy. Today, that space has been transformed into a game room and home theater, but its hidden past adds another layer of mystery to the already extraordinary estate.The mansion itself dates back to the late 19th century and was later designed by Chicago architect Jarvis Hunt. Its interiors retain plenty of Gilded Age character, including a dramatic black-walnut double staircase with carved lions, massive fireplaces, leaded-glass French doors, intricate plaster designs and detailed woodwork.The home also has the kind of entertainment spaces that could easily accommodate a celebrity lifestyle. Its lower level reportedly includes a billiards room, poker area, bar, wine cellar and sauna, while the former gatehouse has been converted into a two-bedroom guest cottage.Outside, the property offers a heated pool, stone terraces and expansive Lake Erie views.So, is this going to be Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s next major home base?There is no public confirmation that the couple plans to make the Ohio estate their primary residence. It could simply be a private retreat for Kelce, a getaway for the couple, or another investment in the NFL star’s hometown.Still, the timing is difficult to ignore.Kelce purchased the property just months before he and Swift’s July wedding celebrations, adding an unexpected Ohio chapter to a relationship that has largely unfolded in the spotlight across Kansas City, New York, and other major destinations.For Swift, Ohio may also offer something increasingly valuable: privacy.Unlike the couple’s highly visible public appearances, a sprawling lakefront estate tucked into a wealthy Cleveland-area enclave offers considerably more separation from the constant attention surrounding them.And perhaps that is the real mystery.The purchase could simply be Travis Kelce returning to his roots. Or it could become something more, a private family retreat, a place to escape the spotlight, or a home where the couple can eventually build a quieter life away from the cameras.For now, neither Swift nor Kelce has publicly explained exactly what they plan to do with the estate.But with its 21,000 square feet, lakefront setting, and secret speakeasy history, their Ohio mansion is already proving to be one of the most intriguing properties connected to the couple.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Travis Kelce’s $320 billion brand endorsements sparked fierce outrage as critics questioned his choices
articles.summary: NFL News: Back in 2023, Travis Kelce was becoming far more than an NFL star. His growing profile was opening doors to major advertising campaigns, but not every.
articles.body: Back in 2023, Travis Kelce was becoming far more than an NFL star. His growing profile was opening doors to major advertising campaigns, but not every endorsement landed smoothly. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end found himself at the center of a conservative backlash after appearing in advertisements for Pfizer and Bud Light. The criticism added another layer to an already busy period in Kelce’s rapidly expanding public life.Travis Kelce’s Pfizer ad sparked criticism in 2023The controversy intensified in September 2023, when Kelce promoted Pfizer’s updated COVID-19 booster and flu vaccine in an Instagram advertisement. The message encouraged viewers to consider getting both shots, reflecting public health guidance at the time.The response was swift. Some conservative commentators and vaccine skeptics attacked Kelce’s decision to promote the pharmaceutical company. His Instagram comments were eventually turned off on the post, but criticism continued across his other social media activity.Among those questioning the endorsement were commentators Megyn Kelly and Charlie Kirk. During a discussion on Kelly’s YouTube channel, Kirk argued that Kelce deserved harsh criticism for taking part in the campaign. Others questioned why a professional athlete with a largely young audience had been selected to promote vaccines.The debate also moved beyond the advertisement itself. Critics challenged the claims surrounding COVID-19 vaccines and raised concerns about potential side effects. Those arguments became part of a much wider political and cultural fight over vaccination that was still active in 2023.Conservative commentator Tomi Lahren also connected the controversy to Kelce’s increasingly public personal life, asking: “Is this what happens when you date Taylor Swift?”Bud Light controversy added to Travis Kelce backlashThe Pfizer campaign was not Kelce’s first encounter with criticism over a major brand partnership that year.Earlier in 2023, he appeared in a Bud Light commercial as the beer company tried to rebuild its image following intense conservative criticism over its partnership with transgender influencer Dylan Mulvaney. The controversy had already triggered a major consumer boycott and put the brand under extraordinary pressure.Kelce’s appearance therefore placed him in the middle of another culture-war dispute. In the short commercial, he joined other men cracking open cans of Bud Light in a football-themed setting. For some critics, the choice reinforced their view that the Chiefs star was aligning himself with brands they opposed.Megyn Kelly summed up that criticism by describing Kelce as “super woke,” while also pointing to his Bud Light endorsement and his relationship with Swift.At the same time, Kelce’s celebrity profile was expanding rapidly. Taylor Swift had attended a Chiefs game against the Chicago Bears in September 2023, fueling widespread speculation about their relationship. Her appearance became a major pop-culture story and brought an entirely new audience into Kelce’s world.The advertising backlash, therefore, arrived at a pivotal moment. Kelce was no longer known only for his performances on the football field. His endorsements, personal life and public image were all receiving unprecedented attention.Looking back from 2026, the Pfizer and Bud Light controversies remain notable examples of how quickly an athlete’s commercial choices can become part of a much larger cultural conversation.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen linked to $32 billion FTX collapse after bankruptcy documents revealed $2 million stakes
articles.summary: NFL News: Back in 2023, Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen found themselves linked to one of the biggest financial shocks to hit the crypto industry. Bankruptcy docu.
articles.body: Back in 2023, Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen found themselves linked to one of the biggest financial shocks to hit the crypto industry. Bankruptcy documents revealed that the former couple held nearly two million FTX shares between them. After the once high-flying exchange collapsed, those stakes were considered virtually worthless, turning a high-profile celebrity partnership into a costly financial setback.Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen’s FTX stakes revealedThe details emerged in January 2023, only months after FTX filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Court documents showed that Brady owned more than 1.1 million common shares in the crypto exchange, while Bündchen held 686,000 shares.The documents did not reveal what either celebrity had paid for their holdings. That made it impossible to determine their exact personal losses. Still, the value of their investments had been dramatically damaged after FTX’s spectacular downfall.Before the collapse, FTX had been viewed as one of the most prominent names in cryptocurrency. The company had reached an estimated valuation of around $32 billion and built a powerful marketing machine around sports and entertainment.Brady became one of its most visible celebrity supporters. Bündchen also joined the company in 2021 as an adviser focused on environmental and social initiatives. Their involvement gave FTX a familiar face at a time when the crypto industry was trying to move further into the mainstream.Brady had spoken enthusiastically about the partnership at the time."It's an incredibly exciting time in the crypto-world, and Sam and the revolutionary FTX team continue to open my eyes to the endless possibilities," Brady said in a news release.Bündchen also highlighted what she believed the partnership could accomplish beyond cryptocurrency itself."This particular opportunity showed us the importance of educating people about the power of crypto while simultaneously giving back to our communities and planet," she said. "We have the chance to create something really special here, and I can't wait to see what we're able to do together."FTX collapse changed the picture for Tom Brady and Gisele BündchenThe optimism surrounding FTX did not last. In November 2022, the company and more than 130 affiliated businesses sought bankruptcy protection after a rush of customers tried to withdraw their money.The crisis exposed a massive financial hole. Reports at the time said FTX faced an $8 billion shortfall, sending shock waves through the cryptocurrency market and damaging confidence in other digital-asset businesses.FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried soon stepped down as CEO. He was arrested in the Bahamas in December 2022 after U.S. prosecutors brought criminal charges against him.The collapse also placed scrutiny on the celebrities who had promoted the company. Brady and Bündchen were not alone among high-profile FTX backers. New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft was also reported to have invested in the exchange.FTX’s new CEO, John Ray III, warned that the company might not be able to recover all the losses suffered by investors and others caught in the collapse.For Brady and Bündchen, the episode showed the risks that can come with attaching a public image to a fast-growing financial company. Their FTX holdings had once represented a stake in a crypto giant valued in the tens of billions. By the time the bankruptcy fallout unfolded, those shares had become a stark reminder of how quickly fortunes can change in the volatile world of cryptocurrency.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: "We don't know if Mahomes can move": Patrick Mahomes injury concern grows as Chiefs quarterback faces crucial test after surgery
articles.summary: NFL News: Patrick Mahomes is cleared, healthy enough to practice and preparing to lead the Kansas City Chiefs into another NFL season. Yet one question is hangi.
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes is cleared, healthy enough to practice and preparing to lead the Kansas City Chiefs into another NFL season. Yet one question is hanging over his comeback. After major surgery on his left knee, can the quarterback still create the chaos that makes him so difficult to defend? League executives surveyed by The Athletic are not ready to give a confident yes.Patrick Mahomes injury puts his mobility under the spotlightMahomes tore both his ACL and LCL in his left knee in December before undergoing surgery on December 15. His recovery has progressed well enough for Kansas City to clear him for full participation in training camp, a major step after such a serious injury.Still, being cleared medically is not the same as proving that every part of his game is back.For Mahomes, movement has always been central to his style. He can escape pressure, change direction, extend plays and throw from awkward positions. Those instincts have helped turn broken plays into some of the biggest moments of his career.That is why the concern from NFL executives matters.One executive told The Athletic, "We know Mahomes is good, but I don't know how healthy he is."Another offered an even sharper assessment: "They need tackles, and we don't know if Mahomes can move," the executive said. "That's one team that could really go either way."The Chiefs have protected their star quarterback during the preseason, keeping him out of exhibition games. That decision gives Mahomes more time to build confidence in the repaired knee before the games begin to count.There was also a notable moment during an August practice. Mahomes rolled to his right, stopped quickly to avoid a defender and then found Rashee Rice for a touchdown. It was only a practice rep, but movements like that offer a better glimpse of his recovery than simply standing in the pocket and throwing.Chiefs face bigger challenges beyond Mahomes’ kneeKansas City cannot afford to make Mahomes' recovery its only storyline.The Chiefs have undergone significant changes on defense. Trent McDuffie and Jaylen Watson moved to the Los Angeles Rams, while Bryan Cook joined Cincinnati. Those departures leave Kansas City with important production to replace.The offensive line also has questions. Left tackle Josh Simmons recently missed practice after head coach Andy Reid said his back issue had "flared up."That makes the protection around Mahomes particularly important. A quarterback returning from knee surgery needs time to operate, especially when his team expects him to regain his trademark mobility.Mahomes is also looking to rebound from a difficult 2025 campaign. He passed for 3,587 yards, 22 touchdowns and 11 interceptions as the Chiefs went 6-11.Now the focus shifts to September 14, when Kansas City is scheduled to face Denver.Mahomes has already answered the first question by returning to full participation. The bigger test will come when defenders are chasing him for real.For the Chiefs, the season may depend on whether their quarterback is merely healthy enough to play, or healthy enough to play like Patrick Mahomes again.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Russell Wilson, Wife Ciara Announce They're Expecting Another Child in Videos, Photo
articles.summary: Russell Wilson may have recently retired, but the former quarterback has something to celebrate heading into football season.
articles.body:
Russell Wilson may have recently retired, but the former quarterback has something to celebrate heading into football season.

Wilson and his wife, Ciara, announced Sunday that they're expecting another child.

The Wilsons have three children together, and Wilson is the stepfather to Ciara's son. The two have been together since 2015 and were married in 2016.

Wilson announced his retirement from football in June after a tremendous 14-year career that featured a Super Bowl when he was a member of the Seattle Seahawks.

The 10-time Pro Bowler is set to join CBS Sports' NFL coverage during the 2026 season.

articles.title: Inspiring story on the woman behind the famous name: “Be confident in who you are and be unapologetically yourself"- How Brittany Mahomes created a legacy of her own
articles.summary: NFL News: For years, Brittany Mahomes was introduced through the name beside hers. Today, that description feels far too small. Long before the headlines, she w.
articles.body: For years, Brittany Mahomes was introduced through the name beside hers. Today, that description feels far too small. Long before the headlines, she was an athlete with her own ambitions. Since then, she has built a career in fitness, stepped into sports ownership and become a visible advocate for women in sports. Her story is less about being married to a superstar and more about creating a life where her own work has a name of its own.Brittany Mahomes built her foundation through soccer and fitnessBrittany’s story did not begin with the Kansas City Chiefs. It began on a soccer field.She played soccer at the University of Texas at Tyler before taking her career overseas to Iceland, where she had a brief professional stint. That experience mattered because it gave her something that cannot be inherited from a famous spouse: an athletic identity of her own. Her background in sports later became the foundation for her work in health and fitness. Sports Illustrated notes that she also earned a bachelor’s degree in kinesiology.In 2019, Brittany launched Brittany Lynne Fitness, turning her knowledge of training and conditioning into a business. It was an important step because she was no longer simply participating in sport. She was building something around what she had learned from it.That distinction helps explain the path she has taken since.Brittany has often presented fitness as part of a broader lifestyle rather than simply a way to look athletic. Her professional background gave her credibility, while her public platform allowed her to reach people well beyond the soccer community.Her journey also reflects a larger shift in how former athletes can build careers. Retirement from competition does not have to mean walking away from sports. For Brittany, it became an opportunity to move from player to entrepreneur.And eventually, from entrepreneur to owner.Brittany Mahomes became a force in women’s sportsOne of the biggest chapters in Brittany’s story began when she became a founding co-owner of the Kansas City Current.The Current’s official history says Brittany, Angie Long and Chris Long brought the NWSL franchise to Kansas City and set out to build something different for players, supporters and the city.That ambition became visible in a way few sports ownership projects had managed before.In October 2021, the ownership group announced plans for a $140 million stadium designed specifically for a women’s professional soccer team. The project became CPKC Stadium, which opened in March 2024. The club describes it as the first stadium purpose-built for a professional women’s soccer team.That is more than a business achievement. It is a statement about where women’s sports belong.For Brittany, the significance is also personal. Soccer was where her own athletic journey began. Now she has a role in creating the environment in which the next generation of female players can compete.The Current has continued to grow into one of the most ambitious organizations in the NWSL. The club’s 2024 season included a league-record 57 regular-season goals and 16 wins, while the team also won the Women’s Cup and NWSL x Liga MX Femenil Summer Cup.Brittany’s ownership role puts her on the business side of that progress. She is not simply watching women’s soccer grow. She is helping invest in the infrastructure around it.That may ultimately become one of the most enduring parts of her legacy.Brittany Mahomes uses her platform to champion confidenceBrittany’s influence is not limited to boardrooms, stadiums or fitness programs. She has also used her public profile to talk about confidence, individuality and the pressure women face in the spotlight.When Sports Illustrated selected her for its Swimsuit issue, she used the opportunity to make the message bigger than a magazine appearance.“I want women to feel empowered to always be yourself, love yourself and feel confident in whatever you do, and I think SI Swimsuit does, too,” Mahomes said. “Be confident in who you are and be unapologetically yourself. People are going to love you or hate you, but finding your values and what makes you the best version of yourself is what really matters.”She added another line that captures the ambition behind her public image:“I want people to know they can accomplish anything, even things you never thought would be possible in your wildest dreams.”Those words matter because Brittany has experienced the other side of visibility too. Being married to one of the most recognizable athletes in America means that her choices, appearance and opinions can attract intense attention.Yet she has continued to put her own work forward.Her message is not that criticism disappears when someone becomes successful. It is that success should not require a woman to become a version of herself designed to satisfy everyone else.That idea has become increasingly central to the way Brittany speaks about her career.Brittany Mahomes is building a legacy beyond the Mahomes nameThe easiest way to tell Brittany Mahomes’ story is to begin with Patrick Mahomes.The more interesting way is to understand what she built before, alongside and beyond that relationship.She has created a fitness brand from her athletic background. She has become an owner in professional women’s soccer. She has helped support an organization that has invested heavily in building a dedicated home for female athletes. And she has used her visibility to encourage women to be confident in their own ambitions.There is also a broader family commitment to giving back. Patrick Mahomes founded the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation in 2019 with a mission centered on improving children’s lives through health, wellness, community support and other charitable causes. Brittany has been involved in the foundation’s community work, including its partnership with Boys & Girls Clubs of America.The foundation’s work adds another dimension to the Mahomes family story. Fame can create attention, but sustained community work creates impact.That difference is important when considering Brittany’s legacy.Her story is not one of escaping someone else’s shadow. It is about refusing to let that shadow define the whole picture.Patrick Mahomes may be one of football’s biggest stars, but Brittany has created a lane that does not depend on throwing a touchdown pass. Her journey from soccer player to fitness entrepreneur and women’s-sports owner shows what can happen when an athlete keeps evolving long after the game changes.The famous name opened doors. Brittany’s work is what keeps them open.And perhaps that is the most inspiring part of her story. She did not need to stop being known as Patrick Mahomes’ wife to become known for something else. She simply kept building until her own accomplishments became impossible to overlook.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: TreVeyon Henderson Injury Updates, Latest News on Patriots RB Ahead of Week 1 vs. Seahawks
articles.summary: With the New England Patriots' season opener against the Seattle Seahawks looming, running back TreVeyon Henderson's status remains up in the air.
articles.body:
With the New England Patriots' season opener against the Seattle Seahawks looming, running back TreVeyon Henderson's status remains up in the air.

Henderson hasn't practiced in two weeks because of an ankle injury, and that didn't change on Sunday, indicating that he's leaning towards missing Week 1.

Henderson is coming off a strong rookie season in which he recorded 911 yards and nine touchdowns on 180 carries, adding 221 yards and a touchdown through the air.

Rhamondre Stevenson was the Patriots' first option in the backfield last year and presumably will be again this year. He recorded 603 yards and seven touchdowns in 2025, missing three games.

Stevenson is healthy heading into Week 1, as is second-year running back Corey Kiner, whom the Patriots acquired from the Arizona Cardinals this offseason, but the depth ends there.

Myles Montgomery is starting the year on the injured list after suffering an ailment during training camp.

ESPN's Mike Reiss noted that the Patriots could choose to bring up Lan Lairsson or Hassan Haskins from the practice squad if Henderson is not able to play on Wednesday.

Lairsson signed with the Patriots after going undrafted last year but spent the 2025 campaign on the injured reserve with a foot injury. Haskins, a fourth-round pick in 2022, spent a year with the Tennessee Titans before playing for the Los Angeles Chargers in 2024 and 2025.

New England will hope to get Henderson back by Wednesday's game, but the team should have a few options to add some depth if he isn't ready to go. Regardless, Stevenson will shoulder the bulk of the carries as the Patriots look to get a revenge win against Seattle after losing the Super Bowl in February.

articles.title: Hailee Steinfeld’s latest career move catches Josh Allen’s attention as Beau Society expands into a new venture
articles.summary: NFL News: Hailee Steinfeld has found a new way to turn a personal passion into a growing brand, and Josh Allen is quietly cheering her on. The actress and Buffa.
articles.body: Hailee Steinfeld has found a new way to turn a personal passion into a growing brand, and Josh Allen is quietly cheering her on. The actress and Buffalo Bills quarterback’s wife has expanded Beau Society beyond her newsletter with a limited merchandise drop. Allen did not need a long public message to show his support. One Instagram Story was enough to get fans talking.Hailee Steinfeld expands Beau Society with new merchSteinfeld’s Beau Society has become more than a newsletter. After reaching its 100th issue on August 28, the actress celebrated the milestone before giving subscribers another reason to pay attention.The latest move is a small clothing collection tied directly to the Beau Society identity. The first drop includes the Beau Society Tee, the “This is BS” hat and the Beau tee.The launch arrived Saturday, with the Beau Society Instagram account sharing photographs of Steinfeld wearing pieces from the collection. Rather than keeping the announcement limited to her own platform, Steinfeld also encouraged readers of her newsletter to check out the limited-edition release.“Surprise! Beau Society merch out now!” read the caption of the post.Steinfeld later described the collection as a limited-edition drop, adding a sense of urgency for followers who want to buy something from the first release."As always, this is a limited-edition drop, so get it while it’s hot," Steinfeld wrote in the 101st issue of her newsletter on Saturday.The move also shows how Beau Society is evolving. What began as a newsletter has developed into a recognizable personal brand, giving Steinfeld a space to connect with followers outside her acting career.Josh Allen shows support for Hailee Steinfeld’s latest moveAllen’s contribution to the launch was far less flashy, but it still caught attention.The Bills quarterback shared the Beau Society merchandise post on his Instagram Story. There was no lengthy caption or elaborate announcement from Allen. He simply amplified his wife’s new project to his own audience.That low-key gesture fits the way the couple has often shared glimpses of their life while keeping much of it private.Steinfeld recently marked another personal milestone when she reached 100 issues of Beau Society. articles.title: ESPN has high expectations for their rookie wide receivers
articles.summary: One ESPN NFL analyst has high hopes for this talented wide receiver duo in Cleveland.
articles.body:
The Cleveland Browns finished 30th in total offense last season, with the passing game particularly struggling, as they finished second-to-last in the NFL. It was clear the main objective this offseason was to bolster that side of the ball, and they accomplished that goal by making a few moves in free agency along the offensive line and drafting both KC Concepcion and Denzel Boston in the 2026 NFL Draft.

According to ESPN's Dan Graziano , this talented duo could be on its way to leading the Browns in receiving in 2026:

Who knows how productive this passing offense can even be, given the grim reality of the Browns' quarterback situation. But to the extent that anyone's catching passes in Cleveland, rookies Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion look like they'll be important parts of the offense right away. Concepcion is an elusive route runner and run-after-catch guy who could frustrate defenses if Cleveland can get him the ball quickly. He was so good throughout August that he won the Maurice Bassett Award, which the Cleveland media gives annually to the Browns' top rookie performer in training camp. Meanwhile, the 6-4 Boston profiles as a traditional "X" receiver who can win on the boundaries with his size and physicality. Jerry Jeudy is still there, the Browns still like Isaiah Bond, and second-year tight end Harold Fannin Jr. can be used in a variety of roles. But the rookie WRs have been camp standouts, and I don't believe coach Todd Monken will hesitate to ask a lot of them right away.

articles.title: How Tom Brady's post-divorce life became a masterclass in putting kids first when cameras never look away
articles.summary: NFL News: Tom Brady has done a lot of complicated things in his career. Seven Super Bowls. Three teams. One unretirement. But nothing he has faced on a football.
articles.body: Tom Brady has done a lot of complicated things in his career. Seven Super Bowls. Three teams. One unretirement. But nothing he has faced on a football field comes close to what he is navigating now — raising three kids across two co-parenting arrangements while the entire celebrity press corps watches his every dinner reservation. Brady shares his oldest son Jack, born in 2007, with ex-girlfriend Bridget Moynahan, and has two more children -- Benjamin and Vivian with ex-wife Gisele Bündchen, from whom he divorced in 2022. The bachelor label followed almost instantly. The father label, he has never let go.Is Tom Brady actually putting his kids first, or is that just his public image?At the Fortune Global Forum in New York in late 2024, Brady addressed the room plainly: "All of the parents in the room know that being a parent is probably the hardest job all of us have and we screw up a lot -- and I've screwed up a lot as a parent." That is not the line of someone carefully managing optics. It is the kind of admission that lands differently when you say it with millions of people watching.The Netflix roast in 2024 gave that tension a very specific shape. Brady called it a "parenting mistake" after his kids came to him the next morning and asked, "What was the point of that? Why did you do that?" He had gone into the roast expecting to laugh at himself publicly. He came out of it with a conversation that, in his words, felt like "a stake through the heart.""They're protective of their mom, of their dad -- of everybody," he said. "You do things as a parent that you think are one way, and then you realize after that it affected the people you care about the most."That is the balance Brady is actually managing. Not the celebrity-bachelor angle the tabloids prefer. The real work is quieter — and a lot messier.What does Tom Brady's dating life actually look like right now?Brady sparked dating rumors with TikTok star Alix Earle during a New Year's Eve getaway to St. Barths at the end of 2025, where videos circulated of the pair getting close at a party. Before that, insiders confirmed in early 2025 that Brady and supermodel Irina Shayk had rekindled their on-again, off-again romance, with a source telling Page Six: "Tom and Irina have started dating each other again and are open to see where things go."What is notable is how carefully Brady keeps any of this away from his children's orbit. A source told Page Six after his retirement that Brady was "all about the kids" and that while friends wanted to set him up, his focus was squarely on family life. Whether that has shifted since is hard to say definitively -- but the pattern of keeping his romantic life at arm's length from his parental one is consistent.As of 2026, Brady has not confirmed any exclusive relationship. In interviews, he has emphasized that his priorities are his children and his post-football career.How is Brady redefining what it means to be a present father after divorce?Tom Brady's most revealing moment this past year was not a paparazzi photo. It was a newsletter. In his 199 newsletter, written partly as a response to golfer Scottie Scheffler's comments about prioritizing fatherhood over athletic greatness, Brady wrote: "My dedication to the sport, the hours of practice, the moments when I was laser focused -- those were times when I believe I was doing the best possible thing for my family and my kids, by prioritizing my profession."He pushed further: "Reading bedtime stories and helping them with homework are not the only ways to be a great parent. And neither is winning Super Bowls or MVPs."It reads, on one level, as a direct response to Gisele's 2022 comment to *Elle*: "I have my children, and I would like him to be more present. I've definitely had those conversations with him over and over again." On another level, it is Brady articulating something he has been working through in real time -- that being a good father does not look the same for every man, and the public version of his life rarely tells the whole story.He also publicly praised his co-parenting relationship with Bridget Moynahan, writing: "To raise a son in the healthiest environment -- and I know we've all done that -- and it shows."With Gisele, he has maintained a similar philosophy. "I think that myself and their mom have done an amazing job of providing that solid base and foundation," he told Entertainment Tonight. "We're never a finished product. The kids aren't finished products. We're learning along with them."Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: How Travis Kelce built a $90 million fortune without ever being the highest-paid player on his own team
articles.summary: NFL News: Travis Kelce has spent 14 seasons in Kansas City without once being the highest-paid player in his own locker room. Patrick Mahomes holds that distinc.
articles.body: Travis Kelce has spent 14 seasons in Kansas City without once being the highest-paid player in his own locker room. Patrick Mahomes holds that distinction by a wide margin. Yet Kelce enters 2026 with an estimated net worth of $90 million, a $100 million podcast deal with Amazon, and brand endorsements that, in 2024 alone, outpaced what Mahomes earned from sponsors. The money trail tells a story the box scores never quite captured.How did Travis Kelce build a $90 million net worth?Kelce's wealth sits on three pillars that grew at very different speeds. NFL contracts laid the foundation. A $46 million extension in 2016, then a $57.25 million deal in 2020, then a renegotiated two-year, $34.25 million agreement in 2024 that briefly made him the highest-paid tight end in the league. Through the 2025 season, those contracts added up to $111.2 million in career earnings, per Spotrac. His 2026 deal, a three-year agreement worth up to $57.7 million but functioning closer to a $12 million guaranteed season, will push that career total past $123 million if he finishes the year.Football money, though, is only part of the picture. Endorsements were the accelerant. Before Taylor Swift attended her first Chiefs game in September 2023, Kelce earned around $5 million a year from brand deals. Within months, that figure exploded. By 2024, Sportico placed his endorsement income at $30 million, tops in the NFL and $3 million ahead of Mahomes. Nike, State Farm, McDonald's, Bud Light, Pfizer, T-Mobile, Old Spice, Tide — the list of brands runs 14 deep. That is not a spokesperson arrangement. That is a media franchise wearing shoulder pads.The third pillar came in August 2024 when Kelce and his brother Jason signed a three-year, $100 million distribution deal with Amazon's Wondery for their New Heights podcast. Travis's estimated share is around $50 million over the term. One podcast deal, in other words, is worth roughly 40 percent of his entire NFL career earnings.Why does Travis Kelce earn more from brands than from the Kansas City Chiefs?The short answer is that his fame long since outgrew the tight end position. Most NFL players earn their biggest checks on the field. Kelce has reversed that equation. His 2026 base salary from the Chiefs is $12 million. His endorsement income in 2024 was $30 million. Add the Wondery deal's annual value and his off-field income exceeds his NFL paycheck by a factor that would have seemed absurd five years ago.Part of this is the Swift effect, which is real and documented. His merchandise sales jumped 400 percent in the 24 hours after her first Arrowhead appearance. Advertisers noticed. Brands that had never associated with football suddenly had a reason to be interested in Travis Kelce. But it would be too easy to credit Taylor Swift entirely. Kelce had been building commercial credibility for years. The SNL hosting gig in 2023, the E! dating show in 2016, a natural ease on camera that few linemen or tight ends ever develop. Swift accelerated what was already moving.How does Travis Kelce's net worth compare to other NFL tight ends?The gap is significant. Celebrity Net Worth places Kelce's fortune at $90 million, well ahead of Rob Gronkowski, George Kittle, and Jason Kelce. No other tight end in NFL history has matched his combination of on-field production and off-field commercial output. Seven consecutive 1,000-yard seasons. Three Super Bowl rings. Twenty postseason touchdown receptions, the most ever at his position. Records that gave advertisers a simple, verifiable argument for writing him a check.The deeper point is that Kelce built $90 million without ever commanding Mahomes-level football money. His largest single NFL contract had an average annual value of $17 million. Mahomes signed a 10-year, $450 million extension in 2020. The gap in football salary is enormous. The gap in total net worth is far smaller, because Kelce made up the difference through podcasting, endorsements, real estate, and equity stakes in brands like Casa Azul Tequila, Garage Beer, and a Kansas City steakhouse he co-owns with Mahomes. He built wealth around Mahomes, not because of him.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Rams expect both Puka Nacua, Alaric Jackson to play against 49ers in Australia despite off-field incidents
articles.summary: Puka Nacua was sued by a woman after several allegations this past offseason, and Alaric Jackson was arrested in June but not charged after a domestic violen...
articles.body:
Los Angeles Rams head coach Sean McVay expects both star wide receiver Puka Nacua and left tackle Alaric Jackson to be on the field on Thursday in Melbourne.

McVay said Sunday that he doesn't believe either player will be suspended for the team's season opener against the San Francisco 49ers, despite their respective off-field issues in recent months.

"Absolutely," McVay said Sunday when asked if he thought both players would be available, via ESPN's Sarah Barshop . "That's what I've heard. I haven't heard anything different."

A woman filed a lawsuit against Nacua earlier this offseason , accusing him of making an antisemitic statement and biting her shoulder. The woman cited gender violence, assault and battery, and negligence in her lawsuit. Nacua has denied the allegations against him.

Nacua was also involved in several incidents last season, i ncluding appearing on a live stream before a game and agreeing to perform an antisemitic touchdown celebration. He entered a holistic care facility this past offseason to focus on his personal growth and has been practicing and preparing for the 2026 campaign normally with the Rams.

Nacua had a career-high 1,715 yards and 10 touchdowns last season while bringing in a league-high 129 catches. The Rams went 12-5 and reached the NFC title game.

Jackson was arrested on a domestic violence charge in June. He was not charged with a felony, however, and his case was assigned for a pre-filing diversion program as an alternative to misdemeanor criminal prosecution.

Jackson is entering his sixth season in the league. The former Iowa standout signed a three-year, $57 million extension with the team in February 2025.

Both Jackson's case and Nacua's case are under review by the NFL. The league could still hand down punishment and suspend either or both players before Thursday's game in Australia (8:35 p.m. ET, Netflix).

articles.title: Did Aaron Rodgers really break the football G-code? Former Patriots star slams Steelers QB over Roman Wilson comments
articles.summary: NFL News: Aaron Rodgers’ decision to discuss Roman Wilson’s mistake publicly has sparked a debate about an old NFL locker-room rule. Former Patriots star Asante.
articles.body: Aaron Rodgers’ decision to discuss Roman Wilson’s mistake publicly has sparked a debate about an old NFL locker-room rule. Former Patriots star Asante Samuel believes the Steelers quarterback crossed that line by putting a teammate’s mistake in front of the media.His criticism came after Rodgers spoke about Wilson following a Sept. 2 practice, where a miscommunication on an underneath route ended with an interception. Former Patriots star Asante Samuel says Aaron Rodgers broke an unwritten NFL ruleAsante Samuel did not hold back when he discussed the situation on the recent episode of “Say What Needs To Be Said podcast” The former New England Patriots cornerback said Aaron Rodgers should have handled the issue privately rather than discussing Wilson’s mistake publicly.“Aaron Rodgers is out of pocket, man,” Samuel said on the podcast. “You never call out a teammate to the media. That’s an unwritten rule. That’s breaking the football G-code.”Samuel also said Wilson and Rodgers would need to talk about the situation if he were in Wilson’s position. His concern was not simply that Rodgers criticized a young receiver. It was that the quarterback made the mistake as part of the public conversation.Rodgers had described Wilson’s error as a “repeat mistake” after the Sept. 2 practice. The play ended with an interception by Steelers cornerback Asante Samuel Jr., the son of the former Patriots star. Rodgers said Wilson had made the same mistake before, but he also made sure to praise the receiver.“Roman is a great kid,” Rodgers said after practice. “He’s had a fantastic camp. I have confidence in him.”That praise is significant because Rodgers did not frame Wilson as a lost cause. Instead, he treated the interception as a lesson during practice. Still, Samuel believes that kind of correction should stay inside the locker room. Mike Tomlin sees Aaron Rodgers’ criticism as a lesson, not a locker-room problemWhile Samuel saw a breach of football etiquette, former Steelers head coach Mike Tomlin offered a much different view during an appearance on “The Rich Eisen Show”.Tomlin defended Rodgers’ approach and said the quarterback was trying to hold Wilson accountable while still supporting his development.“He’s acknowledging that he is a young, developing player,” Tomlin said on the show. “He’s also educating him to the fact that as long as you’re having new issues, then progress is being made.”Tomlin also pointed to the difference between a new mistake and a repeated one. In his view, Rodgers had every reason to demand better execution from a receiver who needs to earn the quarterback’s trust.That puts Wilson in an interesting spot heading into the regular season. The Steelers open against the Atlanta Falcons on September 13, and Wilson now has a chance to answer the criticism on the field.For Rodgers, the issue goes beyond one preseason mistake. He wants his receivers to be precise, especially in a Steelers offense that needs consistency from its passing game. For Samuel, however, the bigger question remains whether a quarterback should ever expose a teammate’s mistake publicly.That is why the “football G-code” debate is not going away anytime soon.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.body:
Kyle Shanahan is embracing the vastly different time zone his team will be playing in this week.

The San Francisco 49ers head coach was asked for an injury update during his press conference, and he joked that he didn't have to give an injury report yet because the team is "technically in the future" being in Australia this week.

The 49ers take on the Los Angeles Rams in Melbourne on Thursday, but the game will technically be on Friday. Kickoff is at 8:35 p.m. ET, or 10:35 a.m. local time.

articles.title: Josh Allen leapfrogs Patrick Mahomes and Lamar Jackson for “America’s Quarterback” title in analyst’s bold NFL take
articles.summary: NFL News: Josh Allen has 30,102 passing yards, an NFL MVP award, and eight seasons of remarkable consistency with the Buffalo Bills. The one thing he doesn't ha.
articles.body: Josh Allen has 30,102 passing yards, an NFL MVP award, and eight seasons of remarkable consistency with the Buffalo Bills. The one thing he doesn't have is a Super Bowl ring. As the 2026 season kicks off, NFL analyst Craig Mish made a striking claim ahead of the Bills' September 13 opener against the Houston Texans -- that Allen has surpassed Patrick Mahomes and Lamar Jackson to become the quarterback most of America genuinely wants to see win it all.Is Josh Allen really "America's Quarterback" over Mahomes and Lamar Jackson?The label sounds bold, maybe even premature. But Mish's reasoning is less about stats and more about public sentiment. He posted a video under the title "Has Josh Allen somehow become America's quarterback?" and what followed was a pretty honest breakdown of where fan affection actually sits across the league."I think this may be one of the rare occasions where fans are rooting for the Bills to win the Super Bowl this season," Mish said. "They're rooting for Josh Allen. I think he's a good guy. I think they would like to see Buffalo win. When Mahomes was winning Super Bowls, I think everyone recognized he's great, but I don't think people were rooting for the Chiefs."That distinction matters. There's a difference between admiring a champion and actually pulling for one. Mahomes has three Super Bowl rings, seven playoff appearances, and a resume that will one day sit at the top of every all-time list. But three titles have a way of making it hard for neutral fans to feel invested. Nobody loses sleep hoping the favourite wins again.Allen is different. He doesn't carry the weight of inevitability. He carries the weight of nearly, always close but not quite, which is a far more human story. Mish put it plainly: "I think everyone's just kind of like, he deserves it. Similar to Lamar Jackson, but not as much. But I think people want to see Josh Allen win."Why does Josh Allen have so much fan support despite never reaching the Super Bowl?Part of it is the Bills themselves. Buffalo is a city that has lived with heartbreak long enough that when things go wrong for them, people outside the fanbase feel it too. The Bills have reached four consecutive Super Bowls in the early 1990s and lost all four. They haven't been back since. Allen arrived in 2018 and turned a struggling franchise into one of the AFC's most reliable teams. In seven full seasons, they have never lost more than six regular season games. And yet the Super Bowl remains out of reach.His 2024 MVP season was arguably his cleanest. Twenty-eight passing touchdowns, twelve rushing scores, and a career-low six interceptions. He also caught a touchdown pass. His 41 total touchdowns made it five straight seasons with at least 40. He threw fewer turnovers, took fewer sacks, and looked more in command than at any point in his career. The numbers told one story. The playoff exit told another.Allen turned 30 in May. The Bills fired longtime head coach Sean McDermott after a Divisional Round loss to the Denver Broncos, promoted offensive coordinator Joe Brady to head coach, and added wide receiver DJ Moore in a trade. The rebuild around Allen is real. So is the urgency.Does Josh Allen have what it takes to finally win a Super Bowl in 2026?The roster around him is arguably better constructed than it has ever been. Moore gives the offense a genuine No. 1 receiver. Joe Brady, who has worked directly with Allen for three years, now has full control of the program. The defense has been upgraded with new personnel. On paper, the window is open.What separates 2026 from previous years is not just talent. It is the absence of excuses. A new coach, a revamped defense, a stronger supporting cast, and a quarterback who has already proven he can carry a team -- if Buffalo falls short again, the conversation around Allen will inevitably shift. Mish's "America's Quarterback" tag is both a compliment and a quiet warning. The public roots for underdogs right up until they run out of chances.Allen knows this. He has spoken openly about not being satisfied with how Buffalo's playoff runs have ended. That self-awareness, combined with everything built around him in 2026, makes the Bills a genuinely compelling Super Bowl story. Whether the ending matches the sentiment is what September through February will decide.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: How Ciara's pregnancy reveal skipped the glam photoshoot and still became the most-talked-about post of the year
articles.summary: NFL News: On Sunday, September 6, Ciara posted a pregnancy announcement on Instagram that had nothing to do with a staged studio setup or a carefully lit matern.
articles.body: On Sunday, September 6, Ciara posted a pregnancy announcement on Instagram that had nothing to do with a staged studio setup or a carefully lit maternity shoot. No wardrobe team, no dramatic backdrop. Just a backyard, a clothesline, four named shirts, and a blank onesie hanging at the end. Seven words in the caption -- "One more person to Love" and the internet did the rest. For a couple that has spent years building one of the most publicly documented families in entertainment, this one landed differently.Why did Ciara's pregnancy announcement go viral without a traditional photoshoot?Most celebrity baby reveals follow a formula. Professional photographer, curated setting, coordinated outfits. Ciara threw all of that out on Sunday. She appeared in a white tank top, low-rise jeans, and hair curlers -- looking every bit like someone who had not planned to impress anyone. The video panned slowly across four white shirts hanging in the sun, each one bearing a child's name: Future, Sienna, Win, Amora. Then came the tiny onesie at the end, blank, unnamed, carrying the entire weight of the announcement without saying a single word.She turned toward the camera with a wide smile, held up five fingers, and that was it. No narration needed. The visual did the work that most announcements spend thousands of dollars trying to manufacture. That authenticity is exactly why it cut through.Vanessa Bryant was among the first to respond, writing in the comments, "It's about damn time. I love you guys so much!!!!! Sooooo happy for you." La La Anthony followed with, "Another beautiful blessing!!! More to love!!!" When your comment section fills up like that within minutes, the post has already won.Did Russell Wilson always want a fifth child with Ciara?The answer to that is not even close to a maybe. At Fanatics Fest in New York City on July 17, Wilson told E! News, "We have four amazing kids and I'm trying to convince Ciara to have a fifth. Cinco, you got to be on the way soon." He was smiling when he said it, but the intent was clear. He added, "I want to have five, Ciara does too. We'll see. Hopefully, I can convince her."Ciara revealed to Us Weekly in July that Wilson had actually brought up the idea of a fifth child shortly after she gave birth to Amora, prompting her to tell him to slow down. That detail matters. This was not a spontaneous decision made in the summer of 2026. Russell had been quietly lobbying for "Cinco" for nearly two years before Sunday's post made the nickname official. When Wilson dropped "Baby Cinco!" in the comments, it was the kind of callback that only lands when you have been saying the same thing for a long time and you finally get to be right.How does baby No. 5 fit into Ciara and Russell Wilson's family?The baby will be Ciara's fifth child overall and her fourth with Wilson. The couple's blended family includes Future Zahir Wilburn, 12, Ciara's son from her previous relationship with rapper Future; Sienna Princess, 9; Win Harrison, 6; and Amora Princess, 2. Wilson has been stepfather to Future Zahir since the boy was a toddler, and he has never treated that role as secondary.Ciara told USA Today in 2025, "Being a mom is my favorite job of all because it really is a job. And God is amazing. I have my four precious babies, Amora, Sienna, Win, and Future, but my husband is my biggest baby."The timing here is worth noting. Wilson retired from the NFL in June 2026 after 14 seasons and joined CBS Sports as an analyst on The NFL Today. A new career chapter, a 10th wedding anniversary in July, and now a fifth baby on the way. The announcement did not feel like a one-off post. It felt like a household that had made several big decisions at once and was ready to share all of them.No due date or gender has been confirmed. The onesie at the end of that clothesline remains blank, and for now, that is exactly the point.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: “Wishing I could slow down time”: Christian McCaffrey's wife Olivia Culpo opens up about watching her little girl grow while preparing to welcome baby No. 2
articles.summary: NFL News: Olivia Culpo is preparing to welcome her second baby while watching her first child grow up right in front of her. The model and mother recently opene.
articles.body: Olivia Culpo is preparing to welcome her second baby while watching her first child grow up right in front of her. The model and mother recently opened up about the emotional side of this stage of life, admitting that she feels exhausted but also wishes she could make time stand still. With Christian McCaffrey back around the 49ers, Culpo is facing a busy new chapter with her family.Olivia Culpo is trying to hold on to the little moments with her daughter before baby No. 2 arrivesCulpo's second pregnancy has come at a fast pace. She and McCaffrey welcomed their daughter, Colette Annalise McCaffrey, in July 2025. Now, just over a year later, they are preparing for another baby.That timing has given Culpo a very different experience of motherhood. She is not entering her second pregnancy as a first-time mom who can focus only on the arrival of a new child. This time, she is also caring for a young daughter who is becoming more active and independent by the day.After Colette's first birthday, Culpo shared how difficult it has been to balance the demands of pregnancy with the feeling that her daughter's early years are moving too quickly.“Can’t believe I officially have a 1-year-old. Currently in the third trimester, chasing around a toddler and somewhere between completely exhausted and wishing I could slow down time to soak up every minute of this chapter. Motherhood really is crazy. Happy bday to my bb girl. You are my whole heart.”Those words captured the mix of emotions surrounding her second pregnancy. Culpo is excited about meeting another child, but she is also aware that Colette's baby stage is already becoming a memory.That feeling has shown up in the small moments she shares with her daughter. Culpo recently gave fans a glimpse of herself doing Colette's hair, joking that her home salon accepts payment in “snuggles or full diapers.” She has also shared photos of the two together, showing how much of her current life revolves around motherhood.At the same time, Culpo recently showed fans how much her pregnancy has progressed. She shared an older photo from when she was three months pregnant alongside a current image of her bump. The comparison gave her followers a look at how quickly the pregnancy has changed.With Christian McCaffrey back at 49ers camp, the family is preparing for another major changeMcCaffrey's return to football adds another layer to the couple's next chapter. Culpo and Colette recently joined him at 49ers training camp, giving fans a glimpse of their family life around his NFL career.For Culpo, supporting her husband while preparing for another birth also means thinking about what the weeks after delivery will look like. She has said she plans to have another C-section after having one with Colette.The timing will be different this time because McCaffrey's football schedule may limit how much time he can spend at home after the birth.“The plan is I'm having a C-section because I had a C-section in July last year, so having a VBAC (Vaginal Birth After Caesarean) wasn't an option. Basically, it's an off day for him, so he'll be able to come just for the birth. And then aside from that, he'll have to go back. So, it's going to be different than my first birth.”That reality makes this pregnancy more than just the arrival of another child. Culpo is preparing to manage life with a newborn and a toddler while McCaffrey returns to the demands of an NFL season.There is also plenty of excitement surrounding the baby. The couple announced their second pregnancy in May with family photos featuring Culpo, McCaffrey, Colette and their dog, Oliver. They have kept the baby's gender private, although Culpo recently joked that the shape of her bump has made her wonder if a boy could be on the way.For now, though, the bigger story for Culpo appears to be the passage of time. She is waiting to meet her second child while trying to enjoy the daughter who made her a mother in the first place.Her words about wishing she could slow down time reflect the bittersweet side of that transition. Baby No. 2 is coming, but Culpo knows she cannot get these moments with Colette back.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.body: An old LeBron James video has suddenly returned to the spotlight after a fan shared it on social media in September 2026. The clip shows James getting into a heated exchange with Houston Rockets centre Alperen Sengun during the Lakers' playoff series in April. The moment already had plenty of emotion, but Patrick Mahomes' response to the resurfaced post gave fans another reason to jump into the conversation. LeBron James clip gets Patrick Mahomes laughing as fans pile into repliesThe game took place on April 2026, when the Lakers faced the Rockets in Game 5 of their first-round playoff series. Los Angeles had a 3-1 lead heading into the game, but Houston kept the series alive with a 119-114 win. The Rockets cut the Lakers' advantage to 3-2 and forced another game.The clip that resurfaced later focused on an exchange between James and Sengun.Sengun appeared to complain about a foul call involving James. The Lakers star immediately responded and made it clear that he did not want to hear that complaint from the Rockets centre.“Did you say soft a** call? Nah, not you. Anybody else on the roster, but not you,” James said during the game.James continued to challenge Sengun, repeating, You don't say that. You don't say that. You don't say that.”After months, a fan brought the old clip back on X. That is where Patrick Mahomes entered the conversation.The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback reacted to the fan's post with a hilarious take: “ No way man🤣🤣🤣”.His reaction quickly drew more attention to the tweet, and fans began sharing their own thoughts.One fan called it a “Tweet of the year candidate.”Another fan had an hilarious take, writing, “Tears in my eyes.”A third fan said, “This video always gets me🤣.”The conversation then became much sharper. One fan compared Mahomes with James while taking a harsh shot at the Lakers star. Another brought up Kansas City's famous 13-second comeback against the Buffalo Bills, asking, “Was it the refs that let them score in 13 seconds?”The same reaction also referenced Damar Hamlin. Not every fan went after James, though. Another user offered a more playful prediction, writing, “Watch him get three more rings before he retires though.”That mix of jokes, criticism and NFL references turned an old NBA clip into a fresh sports conversation. LeBron James previously compared the Rockets with Patrick MahomesThere is an interesting connection between James and Mahomes. LeBron had once brought the Chiefs quarterback into the conversation earlier in 2026 while discussing the Lakers' matchup with Houston.Speaking to reporters, James compared the Rockets' rebounding strength with the Chiefs' passing attack.“They're the best rebounding team in the last 25 years,” James said. “You don't need to have a message. It's like going up against a Mahomes team, they're the best passing team in the last 30 years.”James used Mahomes as an example of the kind of dominance the Lakers were facing. He wanted his teammates to focus on their jobs instead of waiting for a special message before the series.The credentials explained why Houston presented such a difficult matchup. The Rockets averaged 47.7 rebounds per game during the regular season and led the NBA with 15 offensive rebounds per game. The Lakers ranked 27th in total rebounds at 41 per game and 29th in offensive rebounds at 9.4.That comparison also gives the latest Mahomes reaction some extra context. James had already used the Chiefs quarterback as a benchmark for dominance. Months later, an old James video resurfaced, Mahomes saw the fan post and responded with three laughing emojis.The fans then took the conversation in several different directions. What started with a fan reposting an old LeBron James moment ended up becoming another crossover between two of the biggest names in American sports.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Sean McVay Explains Rams' Travel Plans for NFL Australia Game vs. 49ers
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers are already in Australia for Thursday's game in Melbourne, but the Los Angeles Rams won't arrive for a few more days.
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers are already in Australia for Thursday's game in Melbourne, but the Los Angeles Rams won't arrive for a few more days.

Rams head coach Sean McVay revealed the team's travel plans on Sunday, telling reporters they'll fly out on Tuesday night and try to make the trip as short as possible.

"The guys had an idea, but I tell them, 'Hey, let's take it a day at a time, but for your guys' understanding we'll leave on what would be equivalent — I look at it as Friday evening,'" he said. "It's Tuesday night for you guys, but it would be the equivalent of Friday evening. Sleep through the night and then we'll get there and we have kind of a rhythm. But I believe everything that we do, I think our guys, and I would hope — the most important thing to me is they know that, hey, everything we do is what we think is best."

The Niners are taking a very different approach, getting the team to the other side of the world early in the week so they have time to settle in.

"It doesn't mean that we think we're right and a different approach is wrong. It's just what we think is best based on the things that we've done and what we've learned over our time here," McVay said. "That's what will always consistently drive our decision-making processes is with the players first and foremost at the forefront of our minds in every decision that we make and keeping guys in their normal rhythm and routine. Then some of the different things that we've done behind the scenes of people that have done this whether it's different sports or people that have made these types of trips. We've tested it out with some guys and we feel like it's been positive, but that's what went into the approach."

Staying in Los Angeles for as long as possible will, in theory, give the Rams a mostly normal week as they prepare for their season opener on Thursday, but they will have less time to recover from both the jet lag and the time spent on the plane.

"The jet lag didn't hit me that bad," 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey said about the wear and tear of travel. "It's more about how long you're on the plane."

Thursday's game will be the first the NFL has played in Australia, and it's by far the longest trip any team has taken for a game. If anything, it will be a learning experience for other teams about how to approach such a trip.

Whether the 49ers' or the Rams' method is better remains to be seen.

articles.title: Oregon's Matayo Uiagalelei Joins Elite Defense in 2027 Mock Draft
articles.summary: Oregon Ducks star pass rusher Matayo Uiagalelei is predicted to land with an elite defense in the 2027 NFL Draft.
articles.body:
Oregon Ducks star pass rusher Matayo Uiagalelei will be a key piece on defense in the 2026 season.

Uiagalelei was a lead edge rusher for the Ducks in their run to the College Football Playoff in the 2025 season, as he recorded 34 total tackles, 9.5 tackles for loss, six sacks, four pass deflections, two forced fumbles, and a fumble recovery.

He was even more dominant in 2024, with 38 total tackles, 12.5 tackles for loss, 10.5 sacks, two pass deflections, an interception, and two forced fumbles.

Uiagalelei is off to a great start to the 2026 season, as he had eight total tackles, 1.5 tackles for loss, and a sack against the Boise State Broncos.

He is among the best pass rushers in the country and could go in the first round of the 2027 NFL Draft. In Fox Sports' latest mock draft , Uiagalelei is predicted to land with the Seattle Seahawks with the 30th overall pick.

That would be a great landing spot for Uiagalelei, as the Seahawks already have a great defensive line and one of the best defenses in the league.

The Ducks will lean on Uiagalelei as one of their top pass rushers as they look to contend in the 2026 season.

Oregon has other talented players alongside Uiagalelei in the pass rush, as he plays alongside Teitum Tuioti, who also played at an elite level in 2025. He had 68 total tackles, 16 tackles for loss, and 9.5 sacks, along with five pass deflections and two forced fumbles.

With Tuioti and Uiagalelei as the Ducks' pass rush, they are poised to get a ton of pressure on the quarterback.

Oregon has a talented roster and will be in contention to win the National Championship. With all of the talent like Uiagalelei returning, even though they could've gone to the 2026 NFL Draft, this is a major window for the Ducks to make a deep run in the College Football Playoff. If Uiagalelei has another productive season for Oregon, he could be one of the first pass rushers off the board in the 2027 NFL Draft.

articles.title: Shanahan throws shade at Rams: NFL ‘let them off the hook’
articles.summary: Kyle Shanahan believes the 49ers will have a home crowd in Melbourne too
articles.body:
Kyle Shanahan believes that the Los Angeles Rams are so pressed about playing the 49ers at SoFi Stadium that they convinced the NFL to move the game to Australia this season, and San Francisco's coach said on Sunday that it still won't matter. In a press conference just days ahead of their Week 1 matchup, Shanahan said that the league "let the Rams off the hook" by moving a Niners "home game" (aka at SoFi Stadium) to Melbourne, but that "it won't be much different here".

Shanahan expects the same pro-49ers crowd to be present at the Melbourne Cricket Grounds this Thursday.

The 49ers have had an undeniable presence at SoFi Stadium, but Shanahan isn't being shy about his belief that the Rams have pushed the NFL to move the game as to avoid the story this year. ProFootballTalk's Mike Florio has described Shanahan's attitude about the game this season as "salty" regarding the trip to Australia:

49ers coach Kyle Shanahan has been salty about the Rams' desire to export a home game to Australia, in order to avoid yet another San Francisco-fan takeover of SoFi Stadium. Now that Shanahan and the 49ers have hunkered down in Melbourne, Shanahan feels differently. Shanahan currently believes "it won't be much different" in Austrialia — and he expects the so-called Faithful to take over the 100,000-seat Melbourne Cricket Ground on Thursday night. But if the Rams gave up their supposed home-field advantage against the 49ers in order to avoid the embarrassment of having red far outnumber blue in the L.A. venue, it apparently won't be much different for the NFL's first-ever game in Australia.
